title: 第一卷 第1章 边境中的小猎户第一卷 第2章 心生杀意
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
“小毅，我知道这个事你心里膈应，但你别忘了，你这命还是当初二牛哥救回来的，帮帮他怎么了？”
“而且你也不吃亏，实话告诉你，我妹妹刚嫁过去的时候，二牛就废了，现在还是个大闺女。”
“拉帮套是不好听，但你也要想想你现在什么情况，你管那些嚼舌根的做什么？”
听着刘茹在耳边絮絮叨叨的说个不停，李毅一度以为自己是在做梦。
不然都什么年代了，怎么会出现有人劝自己拉帮套？
几分钟前，李毅才刚完成武馆的转让手续，结果回去的路上就撞了大运。
直接把他到一个完全不熟悉的时代。
他现在所处的地方叫做黑石镇，是位于陈国边境的一个小镇。
背景和时间没有一个能跟他记忆中的古代朝代对得上的。
但在某些方面，倒是和弱宋时期有点相似。
原身跟他同名，也叫李毅。
双母双亡，有弟有妹。
平时靠着打猎维持一家生活，过得十分艰难。
前不久弟弟李信还大病了一场，掏光了家底，还借了钱才治好。
现在别说以后得生活，连明天的口粮都没有了。
李毅转头看向刘茹，这女人是住在隔壁的寡妇，平时关系还不错。
她穿着一身粗布麻衫，身姿窈窕，细支挂硕果，明明没吃过几顿饱饭，却仍引人瞩目。
那不施粉黛的面容，更是精致的有些过分，天生的媚眼似是无时无刻在对人放电。
即使是见惯了现代的网红和各式各样的美女，李毅仍旧不免为之惊叹。
见李毅不说话，刘茹更加的生气了。

刘芳是她的亲妹妹，嫁给了隔壁村的李二牛，刚嫁过去那天，李二牛跑去牛棚里喂牛，结果被突然发疯的牛顶到了要害，成了个废人，这些年一直在守活寡。
最近李二牛的身体每况愈下，已经没法出去干活。
这才想到找李毅帮忙，顺带给家里分担一下压力。
不然等李二牛一走，妹妹怕是立马会被吃绝户。
她想着李毅自己一个人带着两个弟弟妹妹，和李二牛家照应着过日子，对两家都是好事，所以才会找到李毅聊这件事情。
此时的李毅也整理好了思绪。
他本就是个思想比较传统的人。
不然他前世也不会死守自家武馆近十年的时间，并且多年如一日的练功。
可惜，虽然练就一身杀人技，但在现代却根本没有发挥的余地。
现在穿越而来，李二牛对前身有救命之恩，李毅继承了他的身份，这个恩情得还，但……是否用拉bang套的方式，有待确凿。
为了避免被刘茹继续唠叨，李毅起身往外走去。
原身居住的环境并不好，只是用木头和茅草简单搭建而成。
家具什么的，基本都是原身自己制作的，但他的木工手艺，只能说一言难尽。
这屋子比李毅后世看过的牛棚还要差，一家三口住在里边，很不方便，毕竟弟弟妹妹大了，也需要自己的私人空间。
看这个屋子，用家徒四壁来形容是一点没错。
屋里边唯一值钱的，也就李老爹传下来的长弓。
可惜，原身并没有继承李老爹那一身出色的箭艺，不然也不会过得那么差。
将长弓和箭袋一起取下来后，李毅来到了院子里，左右张望了一阵，很快就发现了竖立在边上的木靶。
他手里的长弓是一石弓，有效射程在七十米的样子。
穿越前他也曾玩过弓箭，但并不算精通。

不过当李毅架起弓箭的时候，一种熟悉的感觉便涌上心头。
这属于前身留下的肌肉记忆，有这东西，想必他很快就能把箭艺练上去。
然而更大的惊喜还在后面。
当李毅松手，将箭矢射出去的时候，眼前突然跳出个面板。
content_en:
"Xiaoyi, I know you feel uncomfortable with this, but don't forget, your life was saved by Brother Erniu. What happened to him?"
"And you won't suffer any loss. To tell you the truth, when my sister first got married, she was useless. Now she is still a big girl."
"It doesn't sound good to be a gangster, but you also have to think about your current situation. Why do you care about those gossips?"
Listening to Liu Ru chattering in his ears, Li Yi thought for a while that he was dreaming.
Otherwise, no matter how old it is, how could someone persuade me to help?
A few minutes ago, Li Yi had just completed the transfer procedures of the martial arts gym, but he got lucky on the way back.
Directly transporting him to a completely unfamiliar era.
The place where he is now is called Blackstone Town, a small town located on the border of Chen State.
None of the background and time matched the ancient dynasties he remembered.
But in some aspects, it is somewhat similar to the weak Song Dynasty.
The original person had the same name as him, also named Li Yi.
Both mothers are dead, and there is a younger brother and a younger sister.
The family usually relies on hunting to make a living, which is a very difficult life.
Not long ago, my younger brother Li Xin fell seriously ill and emptied his family's money. He had to borrow money to recover.
Let alone living in the future, we don’t even have food rations for tomorrow.
Li Yi turned to look at Liu Ru. This woman was a widow who lived next door, and she usually had a good relationship with her.
She was wearing a coarse linen shirt, with a graceful figure and thin branches. Although she had not eaten many full meals, she still attracted attention.
The face without makeup is even more delicate and a bit too delicate, and the naturally charming eyes seem to be firing at people all the time.
Even though he is used to seeing modern Internet celebrities and all kinds of beauties, Li Yi can't help but be amazed by them.
Seeing that Li Yi didn't speak, Liu Ru became even more angry.
Liu Fang was her biological sister, and she was married to Li Erniu from the next village. On the day they got married, Li Erniu went to the cowshed to feed the cows, and was gored by the cow that suddenly went crazy. She became a cripple and has been a widow for these years.
Li Erniu's health has been deteriorating recently and he can no longer go out to work.
Then I thought of asking Li Yi for help, and by the way, I could share the pressure with my family.
Otherwise, when Li Erniu leaves, my sister will be wiped out immediately.
She thought that Li Yi took care of his two younger siblings and lived with Li Erniu's family. It would be a good thing for both families, so she approached Li Yi to talk about this matter.
At this time, Li Yi also sorted out his thoughts.
He is a person with relatively traditional thinking.
Otherwise, he would not have stayed in his own martial arts gym for nearly ten years in his previous life and practiced continuously for many years.
It's a pity that although he has developed a killing skill, there is no room for him to use it in modern times.
Now that he has traveled back in time, Li Erniu owes his life-saving favor to his predecessor, and Li Yi inherits his identity. This favor must be repaid, but... it remains to be confirmed whether it was a swindle.
In order to avoid being nagging by Liu Ru, Li Yi got up and walked out.
The original living environment was not good, and it was simply built with wood and thatch.
The furniture and other items are basically made by the original person himself, but his carpentry skills can only be described in words.
This house was worse than the cowshed that Li Yi had seen in later generations. It was very inconvenient for a family of three to live in it. After all, the younger siblings were older and needed their own private space.
Looking at this house, it is absolutely correct to describe it as a house with only four walls.
The only valuable thing in the house is the longbow passed down by Father Li.
It's a pity that the original person did not inherit Father Li's excellent archery skills, otherwise his life would not be so bad.
After taking down the long bow and quiver, Li Yi came to the yard, looked around for a while, and soon discovered the wooden target erected on the side.
The longbow in his hand is a stone bow with an effective range of seventy meters.
He had also played with bows and arrows before traveling through time, but he was not very proficient.
NoBut when Li Yi set up his bow and arrow, a familiar feeling came to his heart.
This is the muscle memory left by his predecessor. With this thing, he must be able to improve his archery skills very quickly.
But the bigger surprise is yet to come.
When Li Yi let go and shot the arrow, a panel suddenly popped up in front of him.
